mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q01.stem: Halimbawa ng current meter na hindi kailangang putulin ang circuit?
reasons: May conductor-clamping method; tiyakin ang specifications at target compatibility.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q02.stem: Salt-spray result lamang ba ang same years sa anumang actual environment?
options: Hindi; ihiwalay ang test at actual conditions
reasons: Binalewala ang environment at load differences.
Kailangan ang sample, conditions, at evaluation.
Huwag walang kondisyong i-convert ang accelerated result sa service life.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q03.stem: Same colored product ay iba sa ibang light. Unang tiyakin?
options: Ihambing sa specified source at observation conditions
Laging same color perception kahit anong light
reasons: Huwag process cause bago observation check.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q04.stem: Maaari bang parehong property ang melting point at conductivity sa material selection?
options: Hindi; melting temperature at electrical flow ease ay magkaiba
reasons: Napaghalo ang conductivity at temperature units.
Ihiwalay ang required physical quantities sa comparison.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q05.stem: Ano ang kailangan sa masking na proteksiyon sa untreated area?
options: Material na kayang tiisin ang chemical/temp at tugma sa scope
reasons: Kahit tape, magkaiba ang treatment-environment compatibility.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q06.stem: Angkop na electrolyte explanation sa aqueous current carriers?
options: Nagiging ions kapag natunaw at kaugnay ng conduction
Lahat ng dissolved ay same ion count
Sugarwater laging same conductivity sa saltwater
reasons: Ihiwalay sa free-electron conduction ng wire.
Huwag itumbas ang dissolution at dissociation.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q07.stem: Sa constant current, paano ang charge?
reasons: Hindi nakukuha ang charge sa addition ng magkaibang quantities.

options: Tiyakin ang quantity, meter, personnel; sundin ang correction procedure
reasons: Current unit angA; huwag number-only saV, tiyakin ang actual measured quantity.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q09.stem: Anong requirement ang pangunahing alkali-drip evaluation?
reasons: Resistance ng film sa alkali action.

options: Tiyakin ang applicable sample/state at gamitin sa acceptable boundary
reasons: Tiyakin ang sample state at control.
Hindi arbitrary sample para sa lahat.
Huwag baguhin ang approved criteria sa sariling gusto.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q11.stem: Bago ilagay ang bagong solution sa existing tank, ano ang tiyakin?
options: Compatible tank at lining sa liquid/temp
reasons: Iba ang volume at chemical compatibility.
Kailangan din ang chemical compatibility ng tank.
Suriin bago addition upang iwas accident.

mfg1-surface-weekly-04-q12.stem: Kung hindi 100% ang efficiency, lahat ba ng charge ay target-metal deposit?
options: Oo; wala nang mass measurement kailanman
Mas mababang efficiency, laging mas mataas quality
reasons: May side reactions; kaya hindi laging same ang theoretical at actual.
Ratio ng charge sa intended reaction.
Binalewala ang needed measurements at conditions.
Hindi efficiency lamang ang buong quality.
